label: Brc59 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Brc59 bacteriophage-resistance integron cassette that supports growth during bacteriophage challenge.
observations: Brc59 branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Brc59 proteins, brc59 nucleotide sequences, attC sites, an unresolved normalized gcu59 source key, absent DefenseFinder HMM/rules/article profiles, broad BRiC families, and other mobile integron phage-defense cassettes.
